content: Yosiɑsi
u Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di
Yosiɑsi u Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃. Bɑ ten yɑ̃ku yɛɛ sɑkirɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔn suru ɡbiikoon sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛse sɔɔ.
U yɑ̃ku kowobu doke ben sɔmburu sɔɔ. Mɑ u bu dɑm kɑ̃ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu ko.

U Lefi be bɑ ɡɔsɑ nɛnɛm Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃ bɑ Isirelibɑ keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro dɛɛrɑ te dokeo sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ tè Sɑlomɔɔ Dɑfidi Isirelibɑn sinɑ bokon bii u bɑnɑ. I ǹ mɑɑ tu suɑmɔ senɔ. I de bɛɛ kɑ bɛɛn tɔmbu i Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni sɑ̃.
I de i n sɔɔru sɑ̃ɑ yɛnu kɑ yɛnu kɑ nɡe mɛ Dɑfidi Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko kɑ win bii Sɑlomɔɔ bɑ bɛɛ bɔnu kuɑ bɑ yoruɑ.
I de i bɛɛn ɑyeru mwɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ yɛnu kɑ yɛnu nɡe mɛ bɑ bɛɛn mɛro bisibu Lefibɑ bɔnu sɑ̃ɑ.
Bɛɛyɑ i ko i Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑ̃ku yɛɛ sɑkiri. Yen sɔ̃, i de i tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ, kpɑ i ten sɔɔru ko bɛɛn mɛro bisibun sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u Mɔwisi woodɑ wɛ̃.

Yosiɑsi u tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ bonu wɛ̃ nɔrɔbun subɑ tɛnɑ (30.000) kɑ sere kɛtɛbɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ (3.000) bu kɑ ye kpuro Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ko. Yɑɑ sɑbe ni kpuro nu weewɑ sinɑ bokon ɑrumɑnin di.

Win sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ tɔmbu kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ kɛ̃nu kɑ̃ kɑ nuku tiɑ. Mɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun wiruɡibu, Hilikiyɑ kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Yehiɛli bɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ nɑtɑ (2.600) kɑ sere kɛtɛbɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) wɛ̃.
Konɑniɑ kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli kɑ ben mɛro bisibu Lefibɑn wiruɡibu, Hɑsɑbiɑ kɑ Yeyɛli kɑ Yosɑbɑdi bɑ Lefibɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbu (5.000) kɑ kɛtɛbɑ nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu (500) wɛ̃.
Wee nɡe mɛ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ten kpunɑɑ koosinɑ. Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ bɑ ben ɑyeru suɑ wuu wuukɑ nɡe mɛ sinɑ boko u ɡeruɑ.
Bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɛɛ ɡo. Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ yɛm yɛ̃kɑmɔ mɛ Lefibɑ bɑ bu tĩimɔ. Yen biru, mɑ Lefi be, bɑ yɛɛ yi kokumɔ.

Bɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinun yɛɛ yi nɛnɛm bu kɑ ye tɔmbu wɛ̃ yɛnu kɑ yɛnu kpɑ bu kɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kuru kuɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ yoruɑ woodɑn tireru sɔɔ te Yinni Gusunɔ u Mɔwisi wɛ̃. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ mɑɑ kuɑ kɑ kɛtɛbɑ.
Bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑ̃ku yɑɑ ye wɔ̃ɔwɑ nɡe mɛ woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ. Yen biru, bɑ yɑɑ ye bɑ wĩɑ nɛnɛm Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃ yikuɑ. Mɑ bɑ yɑnde ye tɔmbu kpuro bɔnu kuɑ.
Yen biruwɑ bɑ ben tiiɡiɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobuɡiɑ yikuɑ. Domi yɑ̃ku kowo Aronin bibu bɑ sɔmburu kuɑ sere kɑ wɔ̃kurɔ. Bɑ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kɑ yɑɑ ɡum yɑ̃kunu mɔ̀. Yen sɔ̃nɑ Lefibɑ bɑ bu yɑɑ yikuɑmmɛ.

Wom kowo Asɑfun bibu bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben ɑyerɔ nɡe mɛ Dɑfidi kɑ Asɑfu kɑ Hemɑni kɑ Yedutum, sinɑ bokon bwisi kɛ̃ɔ bɑ woodɑ yi. Mɑ kɔnnɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ yɔ̃ kɔnnɔ bɑɑɡeren mi. Bɑ ǹ doonɛ ben ɑyerun di, domi Lefibɑ bɑ bu ben dĩɑnu kuɑmmɛ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ kpunɑɑ yi dɔmɑ te, bu kɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di, kpɑ bu yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu ko Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku yerɔ nɡe mɛ sinɑ boko u woodɑ yi.
Isireli be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di dɔmɑ te, mɑ bɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ kun seeyɑtiɑ doken tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru.

Sɑɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Sɑmuɛlin wɑɑtin di sere n kɑ ɡisɔ ɡirɑri, bɑ ǹ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ɡɑru diire mɛ Isireliɔ. Mɛyɑ sinɑ boko ɡoo mɑɑ sɑri Isireliɔ wi u Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru diire nɡe Yosiɑsi kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ dɔmɑ te.
Yosiɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu yiru sɑrise sɔɔrɑ bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te di.
Yosiɑsin bɑndun kpeeru
Ye Yosiɑsi u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te sɔnwɑ u kpɑ, yen biruwɑ Eɡibitin sunɔ Nɛko u seewɑ u tɑbu dɔɔ Kɑɑkemisiɔ, dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtiɔ. Yerɑ Yosiɑsi u seewɑ u nùn wɔrim dɑ mi.

Yerɑ Nɛko u nùn sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n sun mɔɔsinɛ nɛ kɑ wunɛ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko. Domi n ǹ wunɛ nɑ tɑbu wɔrim wee ɡisɔ. Yɛnu ɡe ɡɑ kɑ mɑn tɑbu mɔ̀, ɡerɑ nɑ wɔrim dɔɔ. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n doo fuuku. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ ku kɑ Gusunɔ ɡɑbirinɑ wi u kɑ mɑn wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ u ku rɑɑ nun kɑm koosiɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yosiɑsi u yinɑ u nùn deri. U ǹ Nɛkon ɡɑri yi wure yi yi wee Yinni Gusunɔn min di. Mɑ u tii kɔsɑ bu ku kɑ nùn tubu. U dɑ u Nɛko tɑbu wɔri wɔwɑɔ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛɡido.
Yerɑ tɛn towobu bɑ Yosiɑsi twee. Mɑ u win sɔm kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i kɑ mɑn doonɔ minin di, domi bɑ mɑn mɛɛrɑ kuɑ yɑ kpɑ̃.

Win sɔm kowobu bɑ nùn suɑ sɑɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛn di mɑ bɑ nùn doke win tɑbu kɛkɛ ɡɑɑ sɔɔ bɑ kɑ dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ. Mɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bɑ win ɡɔɔ swĩ.
Yeremi u ɡɔɔ swĩ Yosiɑsin sɔ̃. Mɑ wom kowobu, tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu bɑ Yosiɑsi doke ɡɔɔ swĩin womusu sɔɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔ. Su kuɑ wororu Isireliɔ. Womu si, su wɑ̃ɑ ben ɡɔɔ swĩin womusun tireru sɔɔ.

Ye Yosiɑsi u kuɑn sukum, ye u ɡbiɑ u kuɑ kɑ ye u kuɑ dɑ̃ku te, kɑ nɡe mɛ u Gusunɔ sɑ̃wɑ kɑ nɑɑnɛ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn tirerɑ ɡeruɑ, ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ.
Yoɑkɑsi kɑ Yoyɑkimu
kɑ Yoyɑkini bɑ bɑndu di
bɑ wɛ̃ɛnɑ
